problem:
Consider the set $B,$ defined as

$$
B={{b}_{n}\,:\,{b}_{n+1}={b}_{n}+5\,,\,{b}_{1}=2,\,n\in N}.
$$

Which of the following sets is equivalent to $B?$
worked_solution:
The elements of $B$ are all the terms of the *recursive* sequence ${b}_{n},$ given by

$$
{b}_{n+1}={b}_{n}+5,\,{b}_{1}=2,\,n\in N.
$$

Let's write down the first few terms of our sequence:

$$
\begin{aligned}{b}_{1} & =2 \\ {b}_{2} & ={b}_{1}+5 \\  & =2+5 \\  & =7 \\ {b}_{3} & ={b}_{2}+5 \\  & =7+5 \\  & =12 \\ {b}_{4} & ={b}_{3}+5 \\  & =12+5 \\  & =17 \\  & ⋮\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, 

$$
B={2,7,12,17,…}.
$$
